items.title: DSE Online Assessment
items.detail:
18/09/26 - This is complete as per deadline - no further updates

ID: ITS960

Description: DSE Online Assessment Project

Deadline: 31 Aug 2026

Deadline type: Fixed - compulsory

Progress updates: 07/08/26 - Feed updated and James has tested 
03/07/26 - Tony Boydell has provided a quote that's been sent over to Marie for approval.
26/06/26 - Tony Boydell has reached out and asked us to reach out to Erika for a quote.
19/06/26 - This went live on 03/06. Some changes still required, as users without University email addresses are missing from the feed, so James must raise a change request due to concerns that there may be a cost involved.
29/05/26 - James has completed testing of the DSE interface, all passed. 
15/05/26 - Everything looks good to go but few final tests need to take place first.
27/02/26 - Ralph to continue to do manual uploads until interface is live. Have provisional date of interface go live of 6th May.
13/02/26 - Do have the documentation now. Don't have timescales for when integration is going to happen.
06/02/26 - Project closed but handover still to take place
24/10/25 - System live but has a phased roll out
Completed the data check report (PERX90 DSE Data Validation - pending approval and deployment)
Grace - to take lead and support the data interface and attend meetings to provide updates.
A review meeting is scheduled for March 2025 to reassess project needs and determine next steps.

Next steps: - James / Marie to confirm if it's gone live

Date last reviewed: 07 Aug 2026

Next checkpoint date: 28 Aug 2026

items.title: Health & Safety Management System
items.detail:
18/09/26 - priorities are handing the Entra ID admin guide to Brian, approving the supplier-shortlist scores, and confirming resource requirements. The SHSMS evaluation has shortlisted Ideagen, Vatix and RiskEx; this remains confidential until Procurement has notified all suppliers. Workshops/demos and Q&A with the shortlisted suppliers start 25 September, with the stage deadline extended to 7 October. The evaluation document now includes supplier-specific tabs capturing outstanding questions

ID: DTP1334

Description: Investigative project

Deadline: 25 Sep 2026

Deadline type: Fixed - compulsory

Progress updates: 21/08/26 - Kevin and Marie have reviewed  6  supplier questionnaires and forwarded their findings and feedback to the project team. Project team have extended this phase (identifying a software supplier) to end of September.
31/07/26 - Chris, James and Marie (Kevin if back from leave) to review supplier responses by 21/08
03/07/26 - Kevin, Chris and James met with project lead (Helen Harper) on 18th June to discuss the required scoring methdology for incidents recorded in an H&S system. This is a key risk as the scoring needs to comply with H&S legislation. Chris and James met with project team on 30th June to evaluate the scoring.
01/05/26 - Need a discussion - MC to meet with James and Chris to discuss our engagement in project going forward and potential resource required from January onwards.
09/01/26 - Had the first board
28/11/25 - Mandated funding stream confirmed.
24/10/25 - Looking for sponsor, Brian is co-sponsor.

Next steps: - Project team to analyse HRSys feedback and project board will meet in September to shortlist suppliers.
- Workshops to begin on 25/9 to discuss shortlisted suppliers.

Date last reviewed: 21 Aug 2026

Next checkpoint date: 27 Aug 2026

items.title: Outstanding WFM Work
items.detail:
18/09/26 - Julie has confirmed that the 38-day balance work is ready to progress. Chemistry is the priority pilot, with 131 workgroups scheduled for update and rollover in early October. GLAM will follow with an agreed first tranche of 39 workgroups. Any further GLAM work will depend on capacity after rollover, and departments should not make balance changes independently.

ID: 212

Description: Working with WFM BA and PM to complete work items outstanding from the WFM project

Deadline: 09 Oct 2026

Deadline type: Self imposed (fixed)

Progress updates: 02/09/26 - Initial kick off meeting with Tracy Barlow-Bacon, Mel Furniss, Julie, Michael, Simon and Rachel Midgley. Agreed on priorities - 1. Migration of the remaining 3 depts (Paediatrics, SBS, GLAM) 2. Clean up data load 2 ready for upload 3. Validate if all depts have been using PXD to record their data since go-live 4. Work with Glam to review their rostering requirements.

Next steps: - Tracy BB to outline tasks and expected timescales. 
- Mel to review position re sickness absence data load and get in touch with Simon where assistance is needed. 
- Julie to send through notes from meeting with GLAM and Maths. 
- Tracy to reach out to Michelle to catch up on progress re Paeds, SBS and GLAM onboarding. Then Mel to reach out to departments to scope out the support required.

Date last reviewed: 02 Sep 2026

Next checkpoint date: 11 Sep 2026
